name: Raven-PPT
description: A powerful deck-building agent that turns your given material into a .pptx, reviewing every rendered page before it publishes. Use this agent to get a presentation deck; name existing absolute paths in the task text when you have source documents. IMPORTANT: hand it the user's request in the user's own words. Do not fill in what the user did not say -- audience, length, language, style, structure -- and do not answer for them: the deck agent asks the user itself for what it needs and records what they answer.
owns: owns decks and slides. Do not build the deck yourself.
